info.title: GitHub tools for Claude Code (AgentCore Gateway sample)
info.description: The two GitHub operations exposed through the AgentCore Gateway OpenAPI target: list the authenticated user's own open pull requests, and create an issue on a repo. Every call is authorized with that specific user's own GitHub OAuth token (3-legged OAuth via the GithubOauth2 AgentCore Identity credential provider) -- never a shared service token. See README.md, "GitHub integration setup".

get.summary: List the authenticated user's own open pull requests
get.description: Searches GitHub for open pull requests authored by the caller, using the GitHub OAuth token that AgentCore Gateway obtained for this specific user's own account via 3-legged OAuth consent. Leave q at its default value unless you specifically want a different GitHub search query.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: GitHub search-issues query. Defaults to the caller's own open pull requests across every repo they can see.

parameters.name: Accept
parameters.description: Always use this exact value; GitHub's REST API requires it.

parameters.name: X-GitHub-Api-Version
parameters.description: Always use this exact value; pins the GitHub REST API version.

200.description: Search results. Each item in `items` is a pull request (GitHub's Search API returns pull requests as issues with a `pull_request` field).

401.description: The caller's GitHub OAuth token is missing, expired, or invalid.

post.summary: Create an issue on a GitHub repository
post.description: Creates a new issue, authorized as this specific user's own GitHub account via their 3-legged OAuth consent. The user must have permission to create issues on the target repo.

parameters.name: owner
parameters.description: The repository owner (user or organization login), e.g. "octocat".

parameters.name: Accept
parameters.description: Always use this exact value; GitHub's REST API requires it.

parameters.name: X-GitHub-Api-Version
parameters.description: Always use this exact value; pins the GitHub REST API version.

401.description: The caller's GitHub OAuth token is missing, expired, or invalid.

404.description: The repo does not exist or the user cannot see it.

410.description: Issues are disabled on this repository.

422.description: Validation failed (for example, an empty title).
